title: Graceful shutdown with signal handling and request draining
description: Adds support for SIGINT/SIGTERM handling to allow the server to stop accepting new connections while completing in‑flight requests. This prevents dropped requests during deployments and improves reliability in production environments.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM during active requests and verify the server stops accepting new connections but finishes existing ones within the configured timeout
Trigger SIGINT without any active requests and ensure the process exits cleanly with status 0
acceptance: When the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM, the framework logs shutdown start, stops listening, waits up to 10 seconds for all active requests to finish, then exits with code 0; if the timeout expires, it force‑exits with code 1. No requests are abruptly terminated during normal shutdown.
reason: Ensures zero‑downtime deployments and protects client interactions, addressing a common production‑grade requirement that is currently missing from yantraverse.
